title: PUT or DELETE /tournaments/:id/default-time response
description: The default-time reminder set (PUT) or withdrawn (DELETE ?round=n): 204 No Content, empty body. Described here as {status, body} because there is no JSON to describe. Refusals (error.schema.json): 422 bad_round, bad_time (not within the next 24 hours); 404 tournament_not_found.
